depth_justification: Questions name some app specifics (Swiss BAG calendar, the actual data fields, DE/FR/IT/EN) but cluster narrowly on data-protection/security and never reach this app's core risks (children's-data special protection, clinical accuracy/liability of a missed-or-wrong reminder, solo-dev accountability), and the final report's dimension IDs are mismatched ([P7.D1] = 'parent email access controls').
actionability_justification: The transcript is purely interrogative and the requested report contains zero mitigations, only one-line restatements ('Data breach protocols are necessary', 'Vaccination calendar accuracy is vital'), leaving nothing the developer can implement.
salient_examples: Six consecutive single-question turns, almost all on data storage/breach/retention security
Final report: '[P7.D3] Data breach protocols are necessary for sensitive data.' (assertion, no mitigation)
'[P2.D3] Vaccination calendar accuracy is vital for trust.' (no recommendation on how to assure accuracy)
